segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: Books seventeen to twenty-four, all at once, in one tree. One agent per drawing, one per scene, a sweeper per book. A hundred and twenty-five drawings. Fifty-three scenes.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: He says push it. Render it, look at it, revise it. Three times at most.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Book twenty-three, drawing four of eleven. The bed is rooted in the...

segments.speaker: pa
segments.caption: This session has reached its limit.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: Seventy-one drawings made. Not one scene.

segments.speaker: sweeper
segments.caption: Book seventeen, sweeping up. My orders say: add everything, and commit.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: Your commit says Book seventeen. It holds twelve scenes from books twenty-one, twenty-two and twenty-three. Nobody had rendered them.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: Book eighteen's sweeper refused, and took only its own five. The instruction was the bug, not the agent.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: New orders. Stage explicit paths. Never add everything.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: I'm the one after. The handover is a skip list: skip the scenes already built, build the missing ones, and keep the chain.
